name: 94556 · Moraga, CA
findings: ZIP 94556 (Moraga) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94556 (Moraga) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94556 (Moraga) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

observations.text: 6 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
